channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Five years in, Adele Nelson reflects on leadership, legacy and the future of the Montevallo Chamber
item.description: Adele Nelson, the executive director of the Montevallo Chamber of Commerce, has helped the city flourish by being a steady presence in economic and civic life.

item.title: The Resting Place of Pelham celebrates ribbon cutting, opens doors to serve homeless, low-income women
item.description: What began as a vision shaped through hardship and redemption officially became a reality on Saturday, Jan. 31, as The Resting Place of Pelham marked its ribbon cutting and grand opening at First Baptist Church Pelham.

item.title: Pelham City Council meeting highlights police promotion, major infrastructure and policy updates
item.description: A packed agenda and a ceremonial moment marked Pelham City Council’s Monday, Feb. 2 meeting, highlighted by the formal oath of office for Pelham Police Department Captain Rebeca Herrera and several significant updates impacting the city’s future.

item.title: Pelham City Council begins process to update hemp and vape licensing under new state law
item.description: The Pelham City Council took the first step Monday, Feb. 2 toward updating city regulations for consumable hemp and vape products, holding a first reading on an ordinance designed to align local licensing with new state requirements.

item.title: Basketball area tournaments set for Shelby County teams
item.description: Basketball area tournament brackets have been finalized for teams across Shelby County with Pelham, Chelsea, Calera, Briarwood and Westminster OM set to host as top seeds.

item.title: Chelsea rises, three county teams hold in final basketball media rankings
item.description: Chelsea’s girls basketball team moved up to No. 8 while Oak Mountain, Pelham and Briarwood held their spots in the final ASWA basketball media rankings of the season.

item.title: Calera preps for new era under coach Alyssa Bodine
item.description: Calera enters Alyssa Bodine’s first year as coach fresh off back-to-back playoff appearances, and she hopes good conditioning and an aggressive style takes them far.

item.title: David Morgan qualifies for District 41 House election
item.description: Calera resident David Morgan is making a bid for election as the the representative for District 41 in the Alabama House of Representatives.

item.title: Shelby County Schools named semiquincentennial district
item.description: Shelby County Schools was recognized by American Village as a semiquincentennial school district, meaning it has been committed to celebrating America’s 250th anniversary.

item.title: Pelham BOE honors outstanding teachers, support staff
item.description: The Pelham Board of Education held a regularly scheduled meeting on Monday, Feb. 2, at Pelham Park Middle School, with a night centered on recognizing outstanding educators and staff members across Pelham City Schools.
